packagesHeading: Cooler picks for the school holidays
packagesIntro: Choose a hill break, a coast escape or an international plan. We can adjust dates, hotels and pace for your group.
storyHeading: Trade the 45°C forecast for family time
storyParagraphs: April to June can turn a family holiday into a daily hunt for shade. The AC runs, the bill grows, and everyone starts negotiating over the remote. A cooler trip changes the mood. Think pine-lined roads, lake views and evenings when children can play outside while the adults finish a cup of tea.

Comfort Journey was founded in Bhopal by Sharad Kumar Mishra in 1992. Share your dates, group size, preferred hotel level and the places your family wants to see. We can shape a private cab itinerary around nap times, elder-friendly stops and the one relative who needs a snack every 40 minutes.

Stay in a 3-star or 5-star hotel, palace or villa, then travel in a private cab with a driver. For trips abroad, visa assistance is available. Your quote is shared upfront, and real people remain reachable on WhatsApp and phone 24/7 during your trip.

quickAnswer.question: Which summer vacation packages work well for families in India?
quickAnswer.answer: Family-friendly summer vacation packages usually combine cooler hill destinations with manageable travel days, private transport and hotels suited to your group. Comfort Journey can plan India trips such as Shimla-Manali, Dharamshala-Dalhousie, Kashmir and Uttarakhand, or arrange Bali, Phuket or Vietnam. Share your dates and group details on WhatsApp for a customised itinerary and exact quote.

faqs.q: Which months are covered by your summer holiday packages?
faqs.a: These pages are designed for school-holiday trips from April through June. Tell us your exact dates and we will suggest destinations that fit the season and your group.

faqs.q: Which destinations stay cooler in an Indian summer?
faqs.a: Our summer catalog includes hill routes such as Shimla-Manali, Dharamshala-Dalhousie, Kashmir, Nainital and Mussoorie. Weather can vary, so our team will explain likely conditions and travel time before you book.

faqs.q: Can you plan a summer holiday for a large family or group?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around group size, room needs, travel pace, food preferences and activity choices. Private cabs help keep the group together, while the route can include rest stops.

faqs.q: How much do summer vacation packages cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with dates, destination, flights, hotel category, room plan, transport and activities. Comfort Journey shares an exact quote on WhatsApp after learning your requirements.

faqs.q: Can you arrange an international summer holiday?
faqs.a: Yes. The catalog includes Bali, Phuket and Vietnam, along with other international options. Visa assistance is available for international trips, and the team will explain what paperwork is needed.

faqs.q: What support do we get during the trip?
faqs.a: Real people are available on WhatsApp and phone 24/7 during trips. You can contact the team about transfers, hotel questions or changes to the day’s plan.

finalHeading: Give the AC bill a holiday too
finalText: Tell us your dates, group size and preferred destination. We’ll reply on WhatsApp with suitable options and an upfront quote.
